result:
If I could change one thing, it would be to make empathy non-negotiable and contagious.

Not just as a nice idea, but as a default operating system. So that people could actually feel the weight of what they do to others, not abstractly, but in a way that's hard to ignore or rationalize away. 

With that, most of the rest starts to fix itself.
